ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a knot connecting three ropes: one rope is connected horizontally to the left to the wall, and is labeled with tension T = 10 N; one rope is connected vertically downward to a hanging weight, and the weight is labeled W = ?; the third rope extends obliquely upward to the right from the knot and is connected to the ceiling, and the angle between this oblique rope and the horizontal ceiling is labeled 60°. Reasoning: Take the knot as the force equilibrium point. Let the tension in the oblique rope be S. Static equilibrium in the horizontal direction requires the horizontal component of the oblique rope to offset the 10 N tension of the left horizontal rope, therefore S cos 60° = 10. Since cos 60° = 1/2, S = 20 N. Static equilibrium in the vertical direction requires the vertically upward component of the oblique rope to support the weight W of the heavy object, therefore W = S sin 60°. Substituting S = 20 N and sin 60° = √3/2 gives W = 20 × √3/2 = 10√3 N.

raw_record.question_text: A mass with unknown weight \( W \) is suspended from cords as shown. When the system is in static equilibrium, the tension in the horizontal cord is 10 N. What is the weight \( W \) of the mass?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: at a single junction, one cord runs horizontally left and is labeled with tension T = 10 N, one cord runs vertically downward to the hanging mass labeled W = ?, and one cord runs up to the ceiling making a 60° angle with the horizontal ceiling. Treat the junction as the body in equilibrium. Let the slanted-cord tension be S. From horizontal force balance, S cos 60° = 10, so S = 20 N. From vertical force balance, the upward component of the slanted cord supports the downward weight: W = S sin 60° = 20(√3/2) = 10√3 N.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个绳结连接三根绳子：一根绳子水平向左连接到墙上，并标有张力 T = 10 N；一根绳子竖直向下连接到悬挂的重物，重物标为 W = ?；第三根绳子从绳结斜向右上方连接到天花板，并且该斜绳与水平天花板之间的夹角标为 60°。

推理：把绳结作为受力平衡点。设斜绳中的张力为 S。水平方向静力平衡要求斜绳的水平分量抵消左侧水平绳的 10 N 张力，因此 S cos 60° = 10。由于 cos 60° = 1/2，所以 S = 20 N。竖直方向静力平衡要求斜绳的竖直向上分量支撑重物的重量 W，因此 W = S sin 60°。代入 S = 20 N 且 sin 60° = √3/2，得到 W = 20 × √3/2 = 10√3 N。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer matches the standard answer exactly: both give the weight as 10√3 N.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the three forces at the junction act along a leftward horizontal cord of 10 N, a downward vertical cord carrying W, and an up-right slanted cord that makes 60° with the horizontal. Use Lami’s theorem for three concurrent forces in equilibrium. The angle between the downward W force and the slanted force is 150°, and the angle between the leftward 10 N force and the slanted force is 120°. Therefore 10/sin150° = W/sin120°. Since sin150° = 1/2 and sin120° = √3/2, W = 10√3 N.
